items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: We played guitar and alto sax... Alonzo Duke Stewart played drums. See, we weren't at that time playing together in mixed colors.

ctx.x: And very different from Sharky. That was an entirely different sound.

Oh yes. Oh yes. We played guitar and alto sax. Teddy Purnell played alto. Smiley and Joe played guitar. Alton Purnell played piano. Alonzo Duke Stewart played drums. They were all black men. See, we weren't at that time playing together in mixed colors.
